name: Battle Banner
description: Raise the banner of war and grant strength to you and all nearby allies.

name: Blaze Bangle
description: Imbues your attacks with the power of a blazing inferno and looks radiant on your wrist!

name: Blight Bangle
description: Imbues your attacks with poisonous power and looks stunning on your wrist!

name: Blizzard Bangle
description: Imbues your attacks with the power of freezing blizzards and looks really cool on your wrist!

name: Cinder Scepter
description: Hold the scepter to charge it up with souls, then release soul-powered fire on your enemies.

name: Conductive Quiver
description: These arrows will strike your enemies like lightning from the skies.

name: Corrupted Beacon
description: Turns souls into raw power as you fire it in short bursts or in one long, soul-draining blast of ultimate power.

name: Corrupted Seeds
description: Instantly sprout into deadly vines, poisoning and binding your enemies while you reap what you've sown.

name: Creeper Candle
description: Just a completely normal candle, apart from that ominous hss coming from the burning wick... Wait, that's a fuse!

name: Death Cap Mushroom
description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle to enter a berserker state, increasing both movement and attack speed.

name: Echo Ocarina
description: The music of this hollowed husk protects against ranged attacks.

name: Electric Bangle
description: Imbues your attacks with the power of crackling electricy and looks striking on your wrist!

name: Ender Fog
description: The Ender Fog smoke bomb lets you sneak up on enemies, cloaked by shadows.

name: Fighter's Flute
description: The music of the flute grants critical striking powers to any fighter of note.

name: Fighting Fungus
description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, unleashing their rage and increasing their attack speed.

name: Firework Arrow
description: The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow, what could possibly go wrong?

name: Flaming Quiver
description: Light your arrows with the flame of your righteous rage.

name: Freezing Quiver
description: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

name: Grindstone
description: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

name: Honey Dipper
description: A sticky treat to trap your enemies as your buzzing friends join the battle! Victory never tasted so sweet.}}

name: Humbling Horn
description: The music from this mystical horn will knock enemies over and leave their ears ringing. You may need some practice.}}

name: Lightning Rod
description: Channels soul-powered lightning, zapping your enemies silly for as long as you hold it.

name: Picnic Basket
description: Great day for a picnic! Share healthy treats with your friends. Hangry friends make for bad allies in battle.

name: Pouch of Ember
description: Throw it on the ground to spread a fierce fire around yourself. You'll be too hot to handle!

name: Pouch of Frost
description: Throw it on the ground to spread a blistering blizzard around yourself. One of the coolest artifacts there is!

name: Pouch of Thunder
description: Throw it on the ground to spread conductive chaos around yourself. It's a real trip!

name: Powershaker
description: Let's shake things up! The Powershaker is a smashing good time and will blow your enemies' minds!

name: Redstone Mine Launcher
description: This state-of-the-craft launcher will fire a volley of explosive Redstone mines.

name: Soul Harvester
description: Charge it up with the souls you have collected before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.

name: Tempo Truffle
description: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, sending them charging into battle with increased movement speed.

name: Totem of Casting
description: Place the totem on the ground to spread artificing energy to your allies, reducing their artifact cooldown time.

name: Totem of Regeneration
description: This wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire and heals all friends who gather around it.

name: Totem of Shielding
description: This solid gold totem radiates a protective barrier, shielding all inside it from projectiles.

name: Turtle Master's Mandolin
description: A beautiful instrument varnished with Potion of the Turtle Master, granting resistance to all your friends who catch your groove.

name: Venomous Quiver
description: A quiver soaked in venom for that extra sting when your arrows bite.

name: Warding Chimes
description: Chimes crafted from humbler husk. Their music turns your skin as thick as carapace.

name: Warrior Drums
description: Let the sound of drums fill your warrior heart with the power to double damage on all critical hits.

name: Winter Staff
description: Blasts a soul-powered blizzard at your enemies and creates a cozy winter wonderland.

name: Witch Brew
description: A witch's secret formula to throw at your enemies and spread a cloud of weakening vapor. What do they put in this stuff?
